qEn: Which of the following is the national fruit of India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भारत का राष्ट्रीय फल है?
explainEn: Mango is the national fruit of India, known as the king of fruits.

qEn: Which planet is known as the Red Planet in our solar system?
qHi: हमारे सौरमंडल में किस ग्रह को लाल ग्रह के रूप में जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Mars appears red because of iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

qEn: How many states are there in India as of current administrative division?
qHi: वर्तमान प्रशासनिक विभाजन के अनुसार भारत में कितने राज्य हैं?
explainEn: India has 28 states and 8 union territories.
sourceHint: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

qEn: Which organ in the human body pumps blood?
qHi: मानव शरीर में कौन सा अंग रक्त पंप करता है?
explainEn: The heart is the muscular organ responsible for pumping blood throughout the body.

qEn: Which is the longest river in the world?
qHi: दुनिया की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
explainEn: The Nile River, located in Africa, is traditionally considered the longest river in the world.

qEn: What is the primary source of energy for the Earth?
qHi: पृथ्वी के लिए ऊर्जा का मुख्य स्रोत क्या है?
explainEn: The Sun provides light and heat energy which sustains life on Earth.

qEn: Which Indian festival is known as the Festival of Lights?
qHi: किस भारतीय त्यौहार को रोशनी के त्यौहार के रूप में जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Diwali is celebrated by lighting earthen lamps and is known as the Festival of Lights.

qEn: Which is the smallest continent in the world by land area?
qHi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से दुनिया का सबसे छोटा महाद्वीप कौन सा है?
explainEn: Australia is the smallest continent and also functions as a country.
